Me:I bought the Della ice maker for my son for his birthday. I texted him to see how he liked it Below is his side of our text conversation.

Son:It's just not very practical. If I could just fill it up and let it make 10+ pounds of ice, it might be more helpful. But the ice storage area is small.
So you have to micro manage it to produce enough ice to replace buying bags of ice. And it takes a good bit of counter space

Me: We are returning it. It is too pricey an item to keep when you are so unhappy with its performance.

makes ice fast
simole to use

It is a little loud, but overall I can't complain because I have fresh ice every day. After about a month of pretty extensive use, I haven't noticed any issues with the ice production. Overall great product!

Packaged nicely and it was producing ice within about 10 minutes. Initially, the cubes were thin and actually were great for ice-chewing lovers like me. But they were a bit too thin for chilling drinks as they would melt quickly. Overnight, the basket filled up and now it seems not only are the cubes thicker but, like other reviewers, they don't seem to change in size even with setting adjustments. It's okay though....we want cubes for our drinks. Purchase to use in our outdoor kitchen. It says its not "suited" for outdoor use, but our area is fully covered and protected. We will only be using it for parties and, clearly, it will take hours to produce enough ice for larger groups. But with advanced planning, it will be convenient to have rather than always having to buy and lug bags of ice. Our area is detached from the house and several hundred feet away so this will certainly be handy. Definitely recommend if you have a wet bar, game room or area where you might enjoy extra ice. It will take up some space though.
I really like it.  It works just as stated.  The only change I would like is the cubes stay frozen

We love this unit. It makes ice much faster than our new way over priced fridge. Being portable makes this ice maker wonderful, we use it daily at home, when ever we have a gathering, and when we take our fifth wheel out...so it gets used quite often. The price was really great to.
Love it!!

It probably does make 35lbs of ice in a 24 hour period however, it stops making ice when the holding bin is full (about 1lb). Unless you empty the storage bin and have a chilled container to store the ice in, you will only have enough ice for a few cocktails. Not suitable for replenishing an ice chest unless you are willing to nurse this operation all day. Other than that it works great.
I felt duped by the 35lb claim.
Could not believe how fast this unit is,  started had cubes in 17 minutes. Nice looking producr!
quit after one batch of ice.
I love this ice maker it is just wright for my husband and I.  I filter the water before I fill just to make sure it will last longer.  I would buy this again.  We have had it for a month and half.
ice maker works like a champ. i have 2 kid that play sports and need ice and water every day. this machine works great, keeps up with the daily demand like a champ
Better than expected

This ice maker does not do a thing that it is advertised to do. The cubes are so small even on the highest level that you can barely call them a cube. The six minute cube takes at least eight minutes. I am replacing a machine that cost half as much as the Della and did a lot better job. It looks good but that is all.

This is a great little machine for immediate ice needs. Our rental doesn't have an ice maker in the fridge so we can crank this on and have decent amount of ice in an hour. Will run a full cycle and then turn it off until needed again. The only thing is you want to dump the ice into a bucket and put in the freezer often or it gets watery. The unit makes ice quick but doesn't hold cold enough to keep it well frozen.

This one started off wrong. It took a few daYS FOR IT TO START making ice . Unplugged once  has now been unusable since..Its barely 4 months okd and te company that I purchased it from wants nothing to do with it. I have read tat a lot of brands of these type icemakers  stop working completely or stop working correctly after they have been unplugged I have tried all tat i know like resetting and bla blah it still wont work again . Its gonna be a garbage can now.
After going through two other ice makers, this one works, and consistently produces ice. This is the only ice maker I will buy in the future..hopefully not soon.
Very satisfied with the product and the transaction.

I purchased this ice maker for the wet bar in our basement as I was tired of running upstairs every time I wanted a drink or refilling an ice bucket when we had a party or friends over to hang out.  It fits nicely on out counter and makes ice quickly.  I only turn it off when we are going to be out of town; otherwise it's always making ice and ready to go anytime we need it.  If you use the large ice cube setting the ice tends to last longer before melting.  I did purchase the 3 year protection plan for it, but so far so good with no issues.  I would highly recommend this ice machine.

I did not like this product and I wish I could have reviewed it in less than 90 days, but during the 90 day period it works well.  Unit did not last much longer than the 90 day warranty that isn't really listed anywhere.  Two components internally broke, the compressor and the pump.  This unit is not designed for heavy usage, probably once a month or so.  The exterior is sturdy, but the issues come from inside the unit.  However, I have found other products with the same qualities but last for years.

This does not work after 6 months. The past few months it would stop making ice but unplugging it for a few minutes would fix the issue. Now it does not. It makes one cycle of ice and that's it. Would not buy again.
This thing works great so far. The only reason for the 3 stars is the fan turns on and off about every 2 seconds. Maybe that's right. But I don't think so.
Makes a decent amount of ice but for some reason mine doesn't last a year.  This is the 2nd one I've purchased and neither went beyond 12 months.
It was nice while it lasted. We ordered it on August 2, 2016 and as of today 4/12/2017 it has stopped working.

Ordered this item in August. It worked ok but in April it stopped making ice at all. This should not happen on a product less than a year old. We requested a refund. It is now June and we have heard nothing. Our advice, stay away from this product and OneBigOutlet who is the seller!

I wished I read some of the other reviews more carefully, this ice maker worked great for 7 months that is (bought October, 2017). As I read the other reviews now, it seems the ice maker's life is about 6-8 months before it will stop working. Checked for leakage, replace with colder water and do a full reset (turn off let it rest), sadly did not work. I sent a email to request the warranty and customer service number, will update later.

We decided to give this a try, and we were shocked on how well it performs. Hard to believe it can make ice this fast, yes every 6 minutes its dumping out a tray of ice. Don't have to worry about running out of ice here again !!!
Ice cubes melt to fast.  Otherwise, okay

This machine is wonderful - it is fast and the cubes do not melt in the first three minutes of placing them in your drink. The weather has not been really hot as of yet since I purchased it in May - but - as of today I couldn't be more pleased!!!
Bought June 12th 2016. Died June 2nd 2017. If you're cool with buying an appliance that lasts under a year, then proceed. If you're hoping for a little more longevity, I would steer clear.

Was shipped in record time and in good condition.  Have not used it yet as it will be an auxiliary back up for ice on a yacht.  However it looks well made and it's a good size unit, but portable to go anywhere we will need it on the boat....so far...so good.
Produces lots of great ice - I purchased for courthouse and approximately 6 of us use it and essentially always ice available.  Seems heavy and well built.

Around here 20lbs of ice usually runs 5$, In order to fill my coolers for a fishing/boating trip I need at least 3 bags. I decided this would pay for itself after a year or two. I just got it and have been using it heavily and it performs well. Usually after a couple rounds are made I dump the ice into a bowl and stick it in the freezer, then once the buckets full it gets bagged in the deep freezer. I would give it 5 stars but after I run mine for 10 hours straight the coils get too cold on one side and make a big log cube which makes the machine quit working. I turn it off until the cubes unfreeze from the rod, throw the log into the water to cool it and its back at it. I am very happy with it!
It broke 78 hrs after I received it!
Love it, works great and simple to use!
so far so good ,  the  last ice maker I had broke down after six months but it wasn't this model. ask me in six months.
Love the product! The only thing I noticed is it keeps saying its full when it's actually empty. So I just have to open the lid and shut down again. other than that it's good.

Love it. Makes ice fast once started. Love idea as ice melts it goes right back into water reservoir and makes ice all over again. No waste. looks great and little noise. A must for parties, boaters or the ice chest.

The first tank of water produced ice with a machine under taste . We dumped it and since then the ice has been great. Produces ice quickly and in good quantity. We move it to a bin in our freezer so we can use the in-door dispenser. Very satisfied

I really enjoy having the never ending ice that this machine produces.  I have had other smaller ice machines that just could not keep up with the demands of my household for ice.  This machine has fixed those problems.  It is actually a rather quiet machine, the noisiest part of the process is when your hear the sweet tinkle of ice into the basket. For some this model might be too big but I really don't consider it to be. It fits nicely on the counter, at first yoy think there is no way I'm not going to notice this "big" of a machine but now it's just a part of the kitchen.  Having this machine has also freed up so much room in the freezer that was being taken up with ice cube trays.
It was delivered a day early and performed like I hoped it would.  Very Pleased.

Makes ice very fast. Ice seems to last longer in your drinks if you put the cubes in the refrigerator and then use them. Make sure to make a couple of batches before using the ice otherwise they will taste bad.
I like the larger capacity.
Damaged product, had a dent on one side. A screw loose in the back. Also the ice has a terrible taste.
A+ So far so good
this big ice maker is great works better than small one
Very good

I have had this product for two days know. It arrived in a well protected packing. I unpacked it and the protective film on the stainless steel was still in tack which i was happy to see. The ice maker was bigger than i expected, As a few of the reviews stated it did have the fresh off the assemble line smell, so i did wash out the interior bin and freezing poles, checked the drain port which worked as expected. I let the ice maker sit for a few hours on a level surface before i plugged it in. once i plugged it in i filled the water reservoir up to the fill line as instructed and selected large cubes. it took 10 minutes for the first batch of ice to dump into the ice bucket. The first batch was very thin. the ice maker averaged a new batch about every 10 minutes after that. The more ice it created the larger the cubes got as well. i would say it took about 2.5 to 3 hr to fill up the ice basket and the reservoir held enough water for two baskets. as noted it other reviews the ice make it not much of a cooler so it won't maintain the ice for an extend period of time so when the basket is full it advisable to transfer the fresh ice to a zip lock bag and put it in the freezer.
Again i have only had it for two days now just running it to clear the water lines and testing it out. I will be taking it to Key West with me next week in my Travel Trailer which will be the big test to see how she feared. As for longevity and quality of build i will have to wait and see.
It is amazing. It can make ice quickly beyond your imagination. Great choice.

I love this thing. I followed the instructions. I let it set for an hour, cleaned it with a light soup solution, rinsed with water and fired it up. Busting out ice non stop. It's very quite. The only noise is when the cubes drop. I have it at my cabin and need something dependable. I have only used it for two days so keep that in mind.

Used this for the first time while camping over the weekend. Made ice immediately and never stopped. Set to medium sized cubes and they were perfect for beverages. Very pleased with this purchase and with customer service. Unit arrived missing a peg leg. One email to company and I received a pack of 4 in the mail within days. Also purchased extended warranty.  Very happy with this purchase.

This is fast, cubes fall as advertised. And it's not loud. Like a small desk fan. Fridge door maker is not sufficient so I got this, it was a great buy. I fill up a 5lb tray in the freeze in no time.
Shuts off as soon as tray is full. Makes 3 different size. Cubes are cylindrical with open center all they through. Cool drinks fast than real cubes.

Ordered this for my mother-n-law to replace a smaller unit (different brand) that she had used for about 5 years.  She loves the new machine and says it makes ice much faster than her old unit. She really likes the fact that this unit has a drain in the front.
it makes ice like crazy lol.it dumps ice every 6 min.
Love it
Bought this for our RV. It's a little larger than I was expecting but  that's ok. We love it because now we don't have to take up space in our small freezer for ice when we travel.

I live in Texas and have 2 girlswho are catchers in softball all year round. We go through a ton of ice a year..literally! This ice maker produces! I dont know how we've survived without it. If you are always filling coolers, drink thermos's/ yetis etc etc this is your machine to have. I just constantly make ice all week and i fill up a huge dedicated ice tray in my garage freezer(30-50 lbs worth at least) and then empty it every weekend. Its worth its weight in ICE GOLD! The only down side is the ice is kind of wet. So when you put it in the freezer it all freezes together. I just smack it with a wooded spoon to break it up when needed.
Great product this is my second one we ran the last one almost none stop for several years until it finally quit so I am sure of the quality of this product.

works really well.  Makes ice fast.

Amazing how this works! I have found that the medium sized iced cube setting really pumps out the ice! Love it and love the consistency of the ice cubes. A happy camper, we will be!!

The Della Stainless Steel Ice Maker Portable is the best Ice Maker if you need to make lots of ice!  I really love how fast that it produces ice for me,  This Ice Maker makes ice twice as fast as my first ice maker could.
Great ice machine.👍
Started making ice within 30 minutes or less, dumped ice about every 5 - 10 minutes thereafter. We are so glad we had bought this ice maker.
Works well ice cube size is off or would have been 5 star

Bought this for my mom's small town coffee shop, she absolutely LOVES it. It makes out so much ice and she's not having to buy it anymore.
Excellent ice maker. It is a bit noisy and the size of the cubes seems to drop off as the water gets lower in the reservoir. However, it cycles very quickly and has ended the ice wars in our home.
Look great, well made, produces great, easy to operate, great little machine !

This ice maker worked great and I loved having ice everyday, until it stopped working after 9 months. Tried to find a support number and could not find it on manufacturer's website so I filled out the contact form and emailed them as well. I have received no response to either. I called the number on the warranty pdf that is listed on this site, but it went to the re-seller who said to contact the manufacturer's email address after asking when the product was purchased. Support appears to be non-existent. As long as it works, it is a great product, but if it stops working, it looks like you are on your own to repair or purchase a new one even if it is still under warranty. I will try a different brand and hope it lasts more than a year.

We have had this for 3.5 months so feel this review is due. At first, the plastic smell/taste was disgusting. But we ran vinegar (white) through it a few times, then ran and drained all ice a few times, and it is amazing! I leave it running 24/7 and we always have ice (since our fridge ice maker was ridiculously small and then broke!). We can also use it in our RV but it is a little big so goes in storage area underneath with mini fridge.
I see now it is 50.00 cheaper than when I bought it.... and it is fabulous at the price I paid! If you have patience to run vinegar through it, you will not be disappointed.

We had this machine for several months, and then it just stopped working. the Tray that collects the water to create the ice cubes wouldn't move and the whole machine frosted over.  I've tried contacting the seller (one big outlet) and the Della products customer service number.  I haven't heard back from them and I started this process 3 weeks ago.  I think that the product has a one year warranty.  Up until a month ago, it worked nicely (did take a couple weeks to get rid of the plastic taste); makes ice quickly and holds a lot.  I really just want someone to contact me to see if I can get a return/replacement machine or parts.
Great leash. Length perfect for my 7 month old doberman. Wish the shorter handle had padding.

awesome leash. it is perfect length and I love the cushion on the inside of the hand loop. I used it for our hike with my German Sheppard and it held up great it was perfect length. and it feels like a great durable quality. I am very happy with this purchase. and will buy another one soon to use for training our new German Sheppard puppy

This thing is surprisingly awesome. I wasn't really sure that I would get much use of the second lower handle, but I find myself using more often than I thought I would. The leash is a well made thick nylon leash with a matte finished lock, but what sets it apart from the rest in the lower handle. The lower handle is perfect for keeping your dog close when needed, like if another dog walker goes by or if you are in a crowd. I have heard some people just tell their dogs to "heel" and they sit at your side, my dog not so much. So this helps me keep my dog at my side without winding the whole leash around my hand.

I also like that the lower handle Velcros to the main leash to keep it in place when you are not using it.
Great leash!  Especially good for dogs that pull when you need a little extra control.  Very sturdy.
Excellent quality replacement option!!! Nice package to keep your old lenses in if you wish and fit perfectly. Plan to order some more Ina different color just to have.

Perfect leash! After trying various leashes of different lengths with and without the traffic/heal handle, this is the one that fits the needs the best. The length is just right. 6 foot leashes are too long for a dog that doesn't pull. If your dog pulls, it's not had proper training.
Padded handle, d-ring for doggie bags and extremely well made. 5 stars!
Oh, and the price, you can't beat this value.
Wish it came on blue or red though.
LOVE THIS!

This leash is one of the most comfortable leashes to walk my great dane with.  The handles are comfortably padded, and feel that it is more than strong enough to hold my 140 lb. dane back with.  What a great product!

I love this dog lease.If you are trying to train your dog or just want a nice lease this is the item you are looking for.It has a nice long lead for just walking and it has a very nice padded handle as well.The short lead is absolutely perfect for training purposes,you can switch from the long lead to the short lead while you are walking and when you pull up to the stop position it is perfect.Heavy duty leash that is really well made and will last forever.

I bought this product as my dog tries to chew on his leashes. This is a great product. This is very well made and similar to the products found in Petco and Petsmart for a fraction of the cost. Highly recommend!
Seems strong and hopefully durable. The extra grip hook word great.
Good sturdy leash. It's nice that it has a loop on the handle for doggie bags
Really good leash for training dog to heel.  Does not have give in it like other leaches. Handles are in great places. Have dog that is just above my knees and 2 ft handle is in just the right place.
It's great to be able to use the shorter handle in higher traffic and people areas. I only wish it was about 6 inches longer.

My wife loves this leash for our Corgi who tends to use as much leash as you give her to wander.  This leash is just the right length so that she actually walks with you.  Why didn't we get this when she was a pup?!  The second handle gives you complete control when you need it.  Very sturdy also.

My dog is a medical service dog.  When we  are out in shopping, I need to keep my dog close to me.  At the same time, it's a pain to have to change to a long leash when I am able to let him roam or when he needs to potty.  This leash does both jobs.  The leash is easy to hold as either a short leash or long leash.  The fabric is flexible and pliable. The longer length of the long leash does not get in the way the short leash when holding and using the leash.  I did receive this leash as a discount for a review but that does not buy my review.  I recommend this leash highly.

I have a 70 lb dog that can be difficult to walk. My dog gets so excited to go for a walk she tries to walk me. I would have to hold her by the collar and hope that she wouldn't rip my arm off. This leash is exactly what I needed. The dual handles allow me to be in control. I can use the handle at the end to walk my small dog with ease while the shorter handle allows me to keep a tight grip on my large dog. I found it easier to walk my 70 lb dog with this leash than it was with her old leash. I am very happy with this product. I am glad I tried it.
Sometimes you get what you pay for. In this case I would say maybe a little bit more!
This is high quality leash and is really handy for training purposes. The smaller loop allows for tighter control on walks.
Simply love it!

I've owned 5 dogs and about a dozen leashes. This one definitely tops them all! I love the width of the material, strength of the clasp and the wonderful neoprene cushioning in the handle. The second handle for close holding is very useful for holding my dog with traffic is driving by or I need to better control her over-excitement. One warning, however, is that the second handle is only useful for a tall dog because you won't be able to reach it on a small dog without bending over. I also love the velcro strips that are used to secure the lower handle to the leash so that it isn't flapping around and in the way. My dog actually likes to grab the handle as if she's taking me for a walk!
Very durable.

The description doesn't let you know the width of the leash... It's 1 inch. Also the webbing by the handle was frayed, which is not a good sign. Not so sure about the latch either seemed to be a cheaper metal. So definitely not the best for a very large dog that pulls hard.  I was surprised the leash wasn't made better after reading all of the "great reviews" that are listed.
I haven't used it much, but it's the perfect length and seems strong enough for my beautiful Pit Bill!

Awesome! Exactly what I was looking for: a durable, strong, well designed, not too long leash for my doggy. I wanted it with with 2 handles, black, and made with a resistant material. I liked it a lot!
Got this for my mastiff. It is perfect and I love the extra control with the bottom handle.

Love it.  The length is perfect.  My dog likes to stop and sniff so always steps over our 6 foot leash.  The shorter length of this leash prevents that from happening.  There is also a metal ring at the base of the handle, where we attach our little poop bag bullet.  The leash itself is heavy duty nylon and the handle is neoprene lined which makes it comfy.  And the handle that is close to the collar doesn't flop around because it is attached to the main leash line with velcro.  But when you need a short grab, the close handle is there.  Money well spent.  AND, I DID NOT GET THIS LEASH FOR FREE OR FOR A DISCOUNTED PRICE.  I PAID THE FULL AMOUNT!
Better than I expected. High quality leash; sturdy and I love the comfortable handles, swivel clasp to keep leash from twisting, and velcro on lower handle. Awesome :)
great leash very strong perfect for training dogs
This is a good gadget that gives more options while walking a tough to restrain dog.  The dual leash concept is novel & this is a quality product.

As expected and better. Well made heavy clasp and nicely padded, the close in grip might be better 6-12 farther out so it doesn't bumped constantly against the pooch when holding the end grip, but otherwise it will control a small horse!!

Bought this as a Deal of the Day at like half-price to try.  This is a little shorter than our typical 6' leash, but it's great for how we train our dogs. Wish I had bought a 2nd one for our other dog at that price...  Also the clasp seems sturdier than other leash clasps we have, which is reassuring.
Love these!  Like the fact it has the handle located close to the body of the dog too!
gave as a gift

handle is comfortable and the traffic handle is velcroed to the leash...idk why
Bought for a gift. They love the leash. Keeping the dog closer when they walked was a concern.  This leash is perfect.

I chose this one because it says "padded handles"... so I expected both handles to be padded. The main handle is nicely padded, but the short on is NOT. I am very disappointed because this is the handle I would most need the padding (when I'm pulling my large dog away from an issue). Just want other to know what they are getting.

This is a very high quality leash. It only gets 4 stars, however, because the description is a bit deceptive. Only the end handle is actually padded. The traffic handle is just double the leash fabric. It's easier to grab than a single layer, but it's also somewhat stiff in my hand. Since I am short with a tall dog, that's the one I want to hold while walking.The end handle is neoprene padded and perfect--I really wish the traffic handle was just like it. Also, the traffic handle is 14.5 inches, not 12 (as measured from the end of the clip). Great leash, just not accurately described.
The leash is great quality and a great value.
Great leash! This is the second I have purchased and I love it!

I was really happy with it until I was walking my dog one day and the latch mechanism just came off of his collar.  I inspected it and the spring was faulty.  Was only after a few weeks of use and haven't used it since.

Great price for 2 reusable filters. Overall I like the product.
